en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a large hilltop castle complex above a town. The castle has multiple tall, rectangular wings with steep tiled roofs, corner towers with conical roofs, and a small clock- or bell-tower with a spire. Terraced gardens and vineyard-like plantings descend the slope, with stone retaining walls and railings. Below the fortress sit several smaller residential houses with gabled roofs surrounded by dense trees. The landscape beyond is gently rolling farmland. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
